reason: E1 directly confirms phase formation, hardness increase, and a 47.8% wear rate reduction, supporting the core premises. However, the cited evidence does not report a specific hardness increase percentage, so the 30-50% hardness claim is an extrapolation not directly supported by E1.
premises: Laser cladding with TC4+Ni45+Co-WC+Y2O3 hybrid powder on TC4 forms TiC, TiB2, Ti2Ni phases
These in situ hard phases increase coating hardness
The coating reduces wear rate by ~47.8% and friction coefficient by ~10.5% vs. TC4 substrate
Abrasive wear is the dominant mechanism in the coating
The proposed 30-50% hardness increase and 40-50% wear reduction are achievable
